notes.title: Changes to LINE Games OTP Service and Setup Guide
notes.notes:
Thank you for using LINE Games.

To ensure enhanced security and stability, the existing [b]FLOOR OTP service[/b] will be discontinued.
Please review the following changes effective as of [b]Monday, April 21, 2025[/b], to ensure a smooth transition.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[b][Changes to LINE Games OTP Service and Setup Guide][/b]

[b][Changes][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/93233759925b695d12b728e8ff2ff0cf42e5af96.png[/img]

[b][OTP Setup Guide][/b]
- Install either Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator app.
- Please unregister from the FLOOR OTP service and register for the new OTP service starting Monday, April 21, 2025.

[b][Schedule][/b]
- Effective from Monday, April 21, 2025.

[b][Important Notes][/b]
* After the FLOOR OTP service is discontinued, logging into games using FLOOR OTP will no longer be possible.
* Any FLOOR OTP accounts not unregistered by Monday, April 21, 2025, will be automatically disabled.
* Members who choose not to use the OTP service will be able to access our games via email verification.

[h3][b][url=https://cs.line.games/securityCenter/main][Go to Security Center][/url][/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

Thank you.

notes.title: Advance Notice on Upcoming Changes with Jan. 9 Update
notes.notes:
Greetings, Rune Hunters.

There will be various changes coming into effect with the new update that is taking place on Jan. 9 (Thu).

Among these changes, we would like to inform you in advance of the content that will be reset, information regarding the end of Season Re:Birth,
as well as content adjustments that will take place in preparation for the Season 'Trials of Power' update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

◈ Auction House Suspension Measures

◆ Auction House Suspension Measures
After Jan. 6 (Mon) 2024, 11:00 (UTC+9), you will no longer be able to register new items at the Trading Post and Auction House and will not be able to bid on items that have been registered at the Auction House.
Items that have been registered before the patch will remain registered in the Auction House for their remaining time and can be purchased through buyout.

◈ Content Reset

◆ Season Mode Chaos Statue Information
Through the Jan. 9 (Thu) update, the Chaos Compendium Score and Statue Level in the Season mode will be integrated to the higher one between the Season mode and Standard Mode.
※ The Chaos Statue of the Standard Mode will not be reset.
※ Even after the Jan. 9 (Thu) update, Chaos Cards, Traces of Memory, Exodium Cards, and Chaos Key and chests containing them will remain.


◆ Chaos Rune and Chaos Ring Reset
With the Jan. 9 (Thu) update, your Chaos Rune and Chaos Ring of the Chaos Statue will be reset.
※ Upon reset, equipment information of Chaos Rune Cast, Chaos Runes owned in Storage and Bag, and Chest items containing Chaos Runes will be deleted.

If you have any unclaimed rewards saved in the Chaos Ring, please claim them before the maintenance.


◆ Black Market Reset
With the Jan. 9 (Thu) update, the Black Market's Friendship level, item list, saved items, and Pirate's Coins will be reset.

The Pirate's Coins and Pirate's Coin Chests that you own will be deleted with the update.

Your saved items on the Black Market will be deleted after the update, so please purchase them before the Season Trials of Power maintenance.


◆ Relic and Zodiac Reset
After the Jan. 9 (Thu) update, your Relics and Zodiacs will be reset.

Your Relic Level and EXP, and any Light of Life that you own, 
will be combined based on whichever values are higher out of Season/Standard mode.  

All Avatar information will be reset and Divinity Points will be given depending on your combined Relic Level.

Please log in after the update to activate your character's Relic Avatar and reassign your Divinity Points, 
as well as your Zodiac Traits and Stat Points.


◆ Constellation of Time Reset
After the Jan. 8 (Thu) update, your Constellation of Time stage and your Powerful Emotions will be reset.

Please ensure that you complete any Constellation of Time stages you are playing before the update.


◆ Zodiac Stone Emotion Engraving Reset
After the Jan. 9 (Thu) update, your Emotion Engravings on Zodiac Stones will be reset.

You can perform Emotion Engraving again through Constellation of Time after the update.


◆ Solo Descent Raids Reset
After the Jan. 9 (Thu) update, your Solo Descent Raids information will be reset.

Please ensure that you complete any Raid you are playing before the update.


◆ Mastery Reset
After the Jan. 9 (Thu) update, your Mastery will be reset.

Your Mastery Level will be combined based on whichever level is higher out of Season/Standard mode.
Please log in after the update to reassign your reset Mastery Points.


◆ Rune Master Points Reset
After the Jan. 9 (Thu) update, Rune Master Points consumed for The Path of the Rune Master, unlocking Skill Slots, etc., will be reset.

Please log in after the update to reassign your reset Rune Master Points.


◆ Offering System Reset
After the Jan. 9 (Thu) update, your Offering Mission progress and used Offering Points will be reset.

Offering Points from the previous season will be added up and will be able to be used in the new season.
※ Offering Points obtained during the Season Re:Birth remains until the Season Trials of Power.


◆ God's Blessing / Character Traits Reset
After the Jan. 9 (Thu) update, your God's Blessing and Character Traits will be reset.

Please log in after the update to reassign your reset God's Blessing and Character Traits.

◈ Balance and Content Adjustments

◆ Changes to Skill & Link Rune Effects
With the Jan. 9 (Thu) update, certain Runes' effects will be changed.


◆ Balance Adjustments to Skill & Link Runes
- With the Jan. 9 (Thu) update, the balance for certain Runes will be adjusted.


◆ Improvements to Zodiac Nodes
- The effect of the 'Acid Manipulator' Specialization Zodiac will be improved.
- A new effect of the 'Enlargement' Specialization Zodiac will be improved.
- Certain effects of the Specialization Zodiac Cosmos Node will be improved.
- Steel, Sadness, Torch, and Tipan Specialization Zodiacs will be changed.
- Hammer, Wrath, Bonfire, and Flame Specialization Zodiacs will be changed.
- Darkness, Stra, Fisherman, and Sailboat Specialization Zodiacs will be changed.
- Brilliance, Vacuum, Waterfall, and Pirate Specialization Zodiacs will be changed.
- Dawn, Hail, Monsoon, and Sympathy Specialization Zodiacs will be changed.
- Respiration, Corpse, Wisp, and Executioner Specialization Zodiacs will be changed.


◆ Improvements to Gear Options
Through the Jan. 9 (Thu) update, elements of certain Legendary and Ancient options that do not fit their concepts will be adjusted.


◆ Change of Item Stacks
The maximum stacks of certain consumable items will be adjusted.


◆ Improvement of Stat Calculation
The formula of the Movement Speed stat will be improved.


◆ Change of the Rule for Solo Descent Raids Honorable Statue Registration
With the Jan. 9 (Thu) update, the rule for Solo Descent Raids Honorable Statue registration will be changed.

◈ Information on the End of Re:Birth

◆ Season Mode Items That Will Be Moved to Standard Mode at the End of Season Re:Birth
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/fff6602b3aa635dcd25a96910b848885ce021512.png[/img]

◆ Items That Will Be Moved to Temporary Storage at the End of Season Re:Birth
- The items in your Season Character's Storage will be moved to Temporary Storage.
- The items registered in your Season Character's Unique/Rune Compendium will be moved to Temporary Storage.
- The items in your Season Character's Alchemy Slots will be moved to the Temporary Slots per mode.
- The items in your Season Character's Mailbox will be moved to the Temporary Slots per mode.


◆ To note
※ Items stored in the Standard Mode Temporary Storage and Temporary Slot during the Season Re:Birth will be removed after the Jan. 9 (Thu) maintenance and cannot be restored.
 └ If you have any items in the Temporary Storage or Temporary Slot, please obtain them before the beginning of the new season.
※ We will not be able to offer you any assistance for any Black Market items that you do not claim before the Jan. 9 (Thu) maintenance.
※ We will not be able to offer you any assistance for Temporary Storage and Temporary Slot items from previous seasons that have been deleted once the new season begins.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

※ The information may change when the update takes place.

We hope that the information above will help you avoid any inconvenience as you play the game.
 We hope you are looking forward to the new update and Season Trials of Power.

Thank you.

Thank you.

notes.title: New Ways to Use Essences and Attendance Changes
notes.notes:
Greetings, Rune Hunters.
　
Following the Season 5 update, we have carefully considered the feedback from many Rune Hunters and would like to provide some clarifications. 
　
Firstly, regarding the Essences that were refunded due to changes in the Season 5 update:
Upon review, we understand that there is currently no way to utilize the refunded Essences which were based on the quantities of items held from previous seasons. 
Therefore, we will be introducing new ways so you can utilize the refunded Essences to the fullest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/1c8969a8df7f5c68ce0bedd1b992995d617d9198.png[/img]

Secondly, the New/Returning Attendance will be changed to apply to all users.
New/Returning Attendance that was introduced with the Season 5 update were initially intended only for new/returning users. 
However, after receiving your feedback, we have decided to change the criteria of the attendance rewards to apply to all users, in the spirit of greater inclusivity.
　
Thirdly, the minimization (hide/show) feature for equipment options will be added for the mobile version.
We have added the feature, which was initially not a part of this update, for your convenience.
　
This addition aims to assist Rune Hunters experiencing difficulties with equipment enchantments on the mobile version. 
Please read on for more details.
You can now open and close equipment options on the mobile version as shown in the screenshot below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/15b4fb3fdca25cf650eb5ee95b1fcc6233d3b7cc.jpg[/img]

We are very grateful for the ongoing feedback and support from Rune Hunters.
Please keep supporting UNDECEMBER.
　
Thank you.

notes.title: Advance Notice on Upcoming Changes with Jul. 18 Update
notes.notes:
Greetings, Rune Hunters.
  
There will be various changes coming into effect with the new update that is taking place on Jul. 18 (Thu).
  
Among these changes, we would like to inform you in advance of the content that will be reset, information regarding the end of Season 4, as well as certain content adjustments that will take place in preparation for the Season 5 update. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[b]◆ Auction House Suspension Measures[/b]
After the Jul. 15 (Mon) patch, you will no longer be able to register new items at the Auction House and will not be able to bid on items that have been registered at the Auction House.
Items that have been registered before the patch will remain registered in the Auction House for their remaining time and can be purchased through buyout.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[b]◈ Content Reset [/b]

[b]◆ Chaos Dungeon Reset and Current Chaos Cards[/b]
With the Jul. 18 (Thu) update, your current Chaos Compendium Score and Chaos Statue Level will be reset.
  
Chaos Cards obtained before the update that you currently own can be used until the update takes place.
Once the Chaos Statue is reset, you will need to obtain new Chaos Cards in order to play Chaos Dungeons.
  
Any Chaos Cards that you do not use before the Jul. 18 (Thu) update will be converted into event items during the update.
The Chaos items that will be converted include all Chaos Cards and Chaos Card Chests, Chaos Keys, and chests that include Keys.
   
※ Unique Chaos Card Selection Chests, Traces of Memory Selection Chests, Legendary Chaos Card Random Chests (Tier 10), and Rare Tier 10 Chaos Card Chests will not be converted into event items, but Chaos Cards obtained by using Unique Chaos Card Selection Chests will be converted into event items.

[b]◆ Removal of Chaos Stones[/b]
※ Chaos Stones will be removed and replaced with Chaos Points starting from Season 5, which can trigger confirmed events.
※ Chaos Points will reset at the beginning of each season.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/dcf7cc45d38ff70bbb8945e8cb0ea5c481c48cc5.png[/img]
※ Changes are subject to further updates.

[b]◆ Black Market Reset[/b]
With the Jul. 18 (Thu) update, the Black Market’s Friendship level, item list, saved items, and Pirate’s Coins will be reset.
  
The Pirate's Coins and Pirate's Coin Chests that you own will be deleted with the update.
Please purchase any saved items before the update takes place. 
  
Your saved items on the Black Market will be deleted after the update, so please purchase them before the Season 5 maintenance.

[b]◆ Relic and Zodiac Reset[/b]
After the Jul. 18 (Thu) update, your Relics and Zodiacs will be reset.
  
Your Relic Level and EXP, and any Light of Life that you own, will be combined based on whichever values are higher out of Season/Standard mode.  
 
All Avatar information will be reset and Divinity Points will be given depending on your combined Relic Level.
  
Please log in after the update to activate your character’s Relic Avatar and reassign your Divinity Points, as well as your Zodiac Traits and Stat Points.

[b]◆ Constellation of Time Reset[/b]
After the Jul. 18 (Thu) update, your Constellation of Time stage and your Powerful Emotions will be reset.
Please ensure that you complete any Constellation of Time stages you are playing before the update.
  
[b]◆ Zodiac Stone Emotion Engraving Reset[/b]
After the Jul. 18 (Thu) update, your Emotion Engravings on Zodiac Stones will be reset.
You can perform Emotion Engraving again through Constellation of Time after the update.

[b]◆ Mastery Reset [/b]
After the Jul. 18 (Thu) update, your Mastery will be reset.
  
Your Mastery Level will be combined based on whichever level is higher out of Season/Standard mode.
Please log in after the update to reassign your reset Mastery Points.

[b]◆ Rune Master Points Reset[/b]
After the Jul. 18 (Thu) update, Rune Master Points consumed for The Path of the Rune Master, unlocking Skill Slots, etc., will be reset.
Please log in after the update to reassign your reset Rune Master Points.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[b]◈ Balance and Content Adjustments [/b]

[b]◆ Changes to Skill & Link Rune Effects[/b]
With the Jul. 18 (Thu) update, the effects for certain Runes will be changed.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/d9980b39a588ed1bd0770492425fe42a4bc48e2f.png[/img]

[b]◆ Balance Adjustments to Skill & Link Runes[/b]
With the Jul. 18 (Thu) update, the balance for certain Runes will be adjusted.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/8df975061fd6ee56244349faeb7104b9a822facb.png[/img]

[b]◆ Adjustments to Awakened Skill Runes[/b]
With the Jul. 18 (Thu) update, the balance for the Awakening of certain Skill Runes will be adjusted.
After the update, affected Awakened Runes will revert to their normal state, and '[Exclusive] Skill Rune Engraving Stones' will be given.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/70df3f7e49e5a09b2b24f594026fd177d12a9cea.png[/img]

[b]◆ Changes to Energy Effects[/b]
With the Jul. 18 (Thu) update, Energy Effects will be changed.

[b]◆ Improvements to Zodiac Nodes[/b]
- The effect of 'Installation Expert' among the Zodiac Greed Specialization nodes will be improved.
- The effect of 'Go-Getter' among the  Zodiac Greed Specialization nodes will be improved.
- Certain options and the balance of Normal Zodiac nodes will be adjusted.

[b]◆ Improvements to Gear Options[/b]
With the Jul. 18 (Thu) update, options for certain gear will be improved.

[b]◆  Improvements to the Disassemble Feature[/b]
With the Jul. 18 (Thu) update, the Disassemble feature will be improved.
Due to these changes, disassembling the same item before and after the update may result in different Disassemble Results.

[b]◆ Removal of Chaos Stones Following Improvements to Chaos Statue[/b]
During the Season 5 update, the Chaos Statue will be improved, and as a result, the item 'Chaos Stone' will be removed.
Any 'Chaos Stones' that you own will be converted into 'Chaos Points' along with the Season 5 update.

[b]◆ Changes Following Improvements to Enchant Gear and Simplification of Essences[/b]
With the improvements to Gear Enchant and Essences in the Season 5 update, certain Essences will be removed.
All Essences that will be removed will be retrieved, and replacement items will be sent via Mail based on the criteria below.

[b]■ Unavailable and Removed Items[/b]
※ The contents of Chest items containing Essences scheduled for removal will be adjusted.
※ Bundle items registered in the Auction House will be forcibly changed to the designated reward items.
※ Please note that the 2 Essences related to Legendary Unique items will be removed in a later season.
※ All of the Essence Pieces will be removed during the Season 5 update. Please make sure to use all of your Essence Pieces before the update.

[b]◆ Changes to Essences[/b]
Vesper Essence will be improved to be usable on Legendary items as well.

[b]◆ Removal of Alchemy Guaranteed/Reversion Transfer[/b]
Alchemy Guaranteed/Reversion Transfer will be removed during the Season 5 update.
The names and uses of related materials will be changed.

[b]◆ Removal of Alchemy Rune Synthesis Mileage[/b]
※ Due to the removal of the Rune Synthesis feature in Alchemy, any Synthesis Mileage you currently have will be reset.
※ If you have met the mileage requirements but have not claimed their rewards, we will send the rewards via mail.

[b]◆ Removal of Alchemy Formula Page[/b]
After the Season 5 update, the Alchemy Formula category and Formula page items will be removed.
Changes will be made so that some elixirs that could be crafted through the Formula page can be crafted without the corresponding items.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[b]◈ Information on the End of Season 4 [/b]

[b]◆ Season Mode Items That Will Be Moved to Standard Mode at the End of Season 4[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/8cd94f14200c8e6888b801e4e3d88df09b5d326a.png[/img]

[b]◆ Items That Will Be Moved to Temporary Storage at the End of Season 4[/b]
- The items in your Season Character’s Storage will be moved to Temporary Storage.
- The items registered in your Season Character’s Unique/Rune Compendium will be moved to Temporary Storage.
- The items in your Season Character’s Alchemy Slots will be moved to the Temporary Slots per mode.
- The items in your Season Character’s Mailbox will be moved to the Temporary Slots per mode.

[b]※ To Note[/b]
✔ We will not be able to offer you any assistance for any Black Market items that you do not claim before the Jul. 18 (Thu) maintenance.
✔ Items moved to Temporary Storage and Temporary Slots will be deleted if not claimed before the start of Season 5.
✔ We will not be able to offer you any assistance for Temporary Storage and Temporary Slot items from previous seasons that have been deleted once the new season begins.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

※ The information may change when the update takes place.

We hope that the information above will help you avoid any inconvenience as you play the game.
We hope you are looking forward to the new update and Season 5.
  
Thank you.

notes.title: UNDECEMBER Game Operational Policy Changes
notes.notes:
Greetings, Rune Hunters.

UNDECEMBER’s Operational Policy will be revised on May. 2 (Thu) 2024

Please see below for more details on the changes in order to avoid any inconvenience to your gameplay. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[b]UNDECEMBER Game Operational Policy Changes[/b]

✔ Affected Policy: UNDECEMBER Game Operational Policy
✔ Effective Date: May. 2 (Thu) 2024
✔ Key Changes 
3. Protective Health Measures for Customer Service Workers will be added.

✔ Added Information
3. Protective Health Measures for Customer Service Workers
① If, during the consultation process for resolving inquiries arising from game use, any act that disrupts the duties of a customer service worker occurs and causes physical or mental distress to the customer service worker as described in the second paragraph, measures may be taken to limit consultations and game usage to prevent and protect the customer service worker from health hazards under Article 41 of the Occupational Safety and Health Act.
② Acts that disrupt the duties of a customer service worker include the following:
(1) Making an inquiry that includes characters, symbols, images, audio, or videos that induce fear or anxiety.
(2) Making an inquiry that includes characters, symbols, images, audio, or videos that provoke sexual humiliation or repugnance.
(3) Making an inquiry that includes characters, symbols, images, audio, or videos that cause personal insult.
(4) Making an inquiry that contains expressions such as profanity and such that may directly or indirectly cause mental harm.
(5) Making an inquiry that contains jokes or expressions unrelated to the consultation that may cause discomfort.
③ If a customer service worker is disrupted from performing their duties, the following restrictions may apply in accordance with the operational policies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/d24ccb8710b23a5e5bedf8acd53ad0909bacae13.png[/img]
* Disrupting consultation duties may result in the termination of the consultation and game restrictions according to the policies in place.
* If operations are disrupted multiple times after the third offense, the 7-day game restriction may be accumulated.
* If consultation duties are disrupted by multiple accounts from the same device or network connection, it may be considered as being caused by the same user, and game restrictions may be imposed accordingly.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

Please check the Operational Policy page at the effective date to see the revised Operational Policy.

Thank you.

notes.title: Advance Notice on Upcoming Changes with Mar. 28 Update
notes.notes:
Greetings, Rune Hunters.

There will be various changes coming into effect with the new update that is taking place on Mar. 28 (Thu).
 
Among these changes, we would like to inform you in advance of the content that will be reset, information regarding the end of Season 3, as well as certain content adjustments that will take place in preparation for the Season 4 update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[b]■ Auction House Suspension Measures[/b]

[b]◆ Auction House Suspension Measures[/b]
After the Mar. 25 (Mon) patch, you will no longer be able to register new items at the Auction House and will not be able to bid on items that have been registered at the Auction House.
Items that have been registered before the patch will remain registered in the Auction House for their remaining time and can be purchased through buyout.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[b]■ Content Reset[/b]

[b]◆ Chaos Dungeon Reset and Current Chaos Cards[/b]
With the Mar. 28 (Thu) update, your current Chaos Compendium Score and Chaos Statue Level will be reset.
 
Chaos Cards obtained before the update that you currently own can be used until the update takes place.
Once the Chaos Statue is reset, you will need to obtain new Chaos Cards in order to play Chaos Dungeons.
 
Any Chaos Cards that you do not use before the Mar. 28 (Thu) update will be converted into event items during the update.
The Chaos items that will be converted include all Chaos Cards and Chaos Card Chests, Chaos Keys, and chests that include Chaos Keys.
 
※ Unique Chaos Card Selection Chests and Traces of Memory Selection Chests will not be converted to event items, 
    but Chaos Cards obtained through those items will be converted to event items.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[b]◆ Black Market Reset[/b]
With the Mar. 28 (Thu) update, the Black Market’s Friendship level, item list, saved items, and Pirate’s Coins will be reset.
 
The Pirate's Coins and Pirate's Coin Chests that you own will be deleted with the update.
Please purchase any saved items before the update takes place. 
 
Your saved items on the Black Market will be deleted after the update, so please purchase them before the Season 4 maintenance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[b]◆ Relic and Zodiac Reset[/b]
After the Mar. 28 (Thu) update, your Relics and Zodiacs will be reset.
 
Your Relic Level and EXP, and any Light of Life that you own, will be combined based on whichever values are higher out of Season/Standard mode. 
 
All Avatar information will be reset and Divinity Points will be given depending on your combined Relic Level.
 
Please log in after the update to activate your character’s Relic Avatar and reassign your Divinity Points, as well as your Zodiac Traits and Stat Points.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[b]◆ Constellation of Time Reset[/b]
After the Mar. 28 (Thu) update, your Constellation of Time stage and your Powerful Emotions will be reset.
Please ensure that you complete any Constellation of Time stages you are playing before the update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[b]◆ Zodiac Stone Emotion Engraving Reset[/b]
After the Mar. 28 (Thu) update, your Emotion Engravings on Zodiac Stones will be reset.
You can perform Emotion Engraving again through Constellation of Time after the update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[b]◆ Mastery Reset[/b]
After the Mar. 28 (Thu) update, your Mastery will be reset.
 
Your Mastery Level will be combined based on whichever level is higher out of Season/Standard mode.
Please log in after the update to reassign your reset Mastery Points.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[b]■ Balance and Content Adjustments[/b]

[b]◆ Skill Rune Balance Adjustments[/b]
With the Mar. 28 (Thu) update, certain Skill Runes' balance will be adjusted.
Affected Runes that are Awakened will be reverted to the state they were before being Awakened after the update, and '[Exclusive] Skill Rune Engraving Stone' will be given.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/6e6c3dd01789b4c781cdadfd647c67a21f2b9cfd.png[/img]

[b]◆ Link Rune Balance Adjustments[/b]
With the Mar. 28 (Thu) update, certain Link Runes' balance will be adjusted.
Affected Runes that are Awakened will be reverted to the state they were before being Awakened after the update, and '[Exclusive] Link Rune Engraving Stone' will be given.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/6b107c1b713d262aab20489a584819952587bef3.png[/img]

[b]◆ Gear Option Improvements[/b]
With the Mar. 28 (Thu) update, options for certain gear will be improved.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/b2a498f2327a47422869ce9efa912aa374ee41b7.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[b]■ Information on End of Season 2[/b]

[b]◆ Season Mode Items That Will Be Moved to Standard Mode at the End of Season 3[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/22cbf9eda8eff5c01b63bbe92d175c9086b47710.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[b]◆ Items That Will Be Moved to Temporary Storage at the End of Season 3[/b]
- The items in your Season Character’s Storage will be moved to Temporary Storage.
- The items registered in your Season Character’s Unique/Rune Compendium will be moved to Temporary Storage.
- The items in your Season Character’s Alchemy Slots will be moved to the Temporary Slots per mode.
- The items in your Season Character’s Mailbox will be moved to the Temporary Slots per mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[b]※ To Note[/b]
✔ We will not be able to offer you any assistance for any Black Market items that you do not claim before the Mar. 28 (Thu) maintenance.
✔ Items moved to Temporary Storage and Temporary Slots will be deleted if not claimed before the start of Season 5.
✔ We will not be able to offer you any assistance for Temporary Storage and Temporary Slot items from previous seasons that have been deleted once the new season begins.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

We hope that the information above will help you avoid any inconvenience as you play the game.
We hope you are looking forward to the new update and Season 4.
 
Thank you.

notes.title: Advance Notice on Upcoming Changes with Dec. 7 Update
notes.notes:
Greetings, Rune Hunters.

There will be various changes coming into effect with the new update that is taking place on Dec. 7 (Thu).

Among these changes, we would like to inform you in advance of the content that will be reset, information regarding the end of Season 2, 
as well as content adjustments that will take place in preparation for the Season 3 update.

[b]■ Auction House Suspension Measures[/b]

[b]◆ Auction House Suspension Measures[/b]

After the Dec. 4 (Mon). patch, you will no longer be able to register new items at the Auction House.
Items that are registered before the patch will remain registered in the Auction House for their remaining time.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]
[b]■ Content Reset[/b]

[b]◆ Chaos Dungeon Reset and Current Chaos Cards[/b]

With the Dec. 7 (Thu) update, your current Chaos Compendium Score and Chaos Statue Level will be reset.

Chaos Cards obtained before the update that you currently own can be used until the update takes place.
Once the Chaos Statue is reset, you will need to obtain new Chaos Cards in order to play Chaos Dungeons.

Any Chaos Cards that you do not use before the Dec. 7 (Thu) update will be converted into event items during the update. 
The Chaos items that will be converted include all Chaos Cards and Chaos Card Chests, Chaos Keys and chests that include Chaos Keys.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]
[b]◆ Black Market Reset[/b]

With the Dec. 7 (Thu) update, the Black Market’s Friendship level, item list, saved items, and Pirate’s Coins will be reset.

The Pirate's Coins and Pirate's Coin Chests that you own will be deleted with the update.
Please purchase any saved items before the update takes place. 

Your saved items on the Black Market will be deleted after the update, so please purchase them before the Season 3 maintenance takes place.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]
[b]◆ Relic and Zodiac Reset[/b]
After the Dec. 7 (Thu) update, your Relics and Zodiacs will be reset.

Your Relic Level and EXP, and any Light of Life that you own, will be combined based on whichever values are higher out of Season/Standard mode. 

All Avatar information will be reset and Divinity Points will be given depending on your combined Relic Level.

Please log in after the update to activate your character’s Relic Avatar and reassign your Divinity Points, as well as your Zodiac Traits and Stat Points.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]
[b]◆ Constellation of Time Reset[/b]

After the Dec. 7 (Thu) update, your Constellation of Time stage and your Powerful Emotions will be reset.
Please ensure that you complete any Constellation of Time stages you are playing before the update.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]
[b]◆ Zodiac Stone Emotion Engraving Reset[/b]
After the Dec. 7 (Thu) update, your Emotion Engravings on Zodiac Stones will be reset.
You can perform Emotion Engraving again through Constellation of Time after the update.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]
[b]◆ Mastery Reset[/b]
After the Dec. 7 (Thu) update, your Mastery will be reset.

Your Mastery Level will be combined based on whichever level is higher out of Season/Standard mode.
Please log in after the update to reassign your reset Mastery Points.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]
[b]■ Balance and Content Adjustments[/b]
◆ Crusade of Glory Closure
After the Dec. 7 (Thu) update, the game's Crusade of Glory content will be permanently closed.

After the Dec. 7 (Thu) update, we will send the following rewards according to grade to Rune Hunters who played Crusade of Glory during Season 2.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/758a10dffdb7c39f4357e4227893872e72738924.png[/img]
※ The Crusade of Glory Shop will only remain open during Season 3, and any 'Brilliant Glory Coins' that you own will be deleted once Season 4 begins.

We would like to sincerely thank you for playing Crusade of Glory.

◆ Free Pet Ability
After the Dec. 7 (Thu) update, Pet Abilities will be free.

We will be issuing compensation to Rune Hunters who purchased Pet Abilities during Season 2 and still have remaining days or have yet to use them,  and the compensation will be dependent on these factors.

- The compensation will be sent in succession during a period of 1-2 weeks after the Dec. 7 (Thu) update.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]
[b]■ Information on End of Season 2[/b]

[b]◆ Season Mode Items that will Move to Standard Mode at End of Season 2[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/ecce2037ef133c3a2c47a5ce7edff15cd10f678a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]
[b]◆ Items that will Move to Temporary Storage at End of Season 2[/b]
- The items in your Season Character’s Storage will be moved to Temporary Storage.
- The items registered in your Season Character’s Unique/Rune Compendium will be moved to Temporary Storage.
- The items in your Season Character’s Alchemy Slots will be moved to Temporary Slots according to mode.
- The items in your Season Character’s Mailbox will be moved to Temporary Slots according to mode.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]
[b]※ To Note[/b]
✔ We will not be able to offer you any assistance for any Black Market items that you do not claim before the Dec. 7 (Thu) maintenance.
✔ Items moved to Temporary Storage and Temporary Slots will be deleted if not claimed before the start of Season 4.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]
We hope that the information above will help you avoid any inconvenience as you play the game.
We hope you are looking forward to the new update and Season 3.

Thank you.

notes.title: Notice Regarding Zodiac Point Decrease after Oct. 12 Update
notes.notes:
Greetings, Rune Hunters.

This is a notice for Rune Hunters whose Zodiacs were reset or whose Zodiac Points decreased after the Oct. 12 (Thu) scheduled maintenance.

The two situations mentioned above occurred while adjusting the Zodiac Points of certain characters to be within normal ranges. Certain characters had abnormally high Zodiac Points due to obtaining the 'Stardust of Evolution' from a bug before the Oct. 12 (Thu) scheduled maintenance.

'Stardust of Evolution' and 'Stardust of Evolution Ⅱ', which can be used to earn Zodiac Points, are obtainable through Saluto's Chaos Sub Quest. All items can be acquired after completing the four quests below.

■ Quests where Stardust of Evolution can be obtained
1) Long-haired Stranger (Talk to Leon)
2) Direction of Worry (Talk to Leon)

■ Quests where Stardust of Evolution Ⅱ can be obtained
1) Resurrecting Evil (Defeat Serpens)
2) Shadow Game (Talk to the Long-haired Stranger)

Please keep in mind that Zodiac Specialization Points can be invested to the maximum level after completing all of the Chaos Sub Quests above and using the Stardust of Evolution.

Thank you.

notes.title: Delay in Guild Raid Update Schedule
notes.notes:
Greetings, Rune Hunters.

We would first like to sincerely apologize to all the Rune Hunters who were looking forward to the Season 2 new content, 'Guild Raids'.

Although we announced that the first 'Guild Raid' would begin on [b]Sept. 14 (Thu)[/b] in our Aug. 31 Update notice,
we found during our test stages that a crucial change has to be made to the content,
meaning that the [b]Guild Raid update schedule[/b] must unavoidably be [b]delayed[/b] until [u][b]Oct. 12 (Thu)[/b][/u].

Including the change that needs to be made, we will carefully examine all aspects of the Guild Raid content,
and ensure that we can present Rune Hunters with the best and most complete version of the new content.

We ask for your understanding in this unavoidable delay in schedule.

We have prepared compensation as an apology for this delay.
Please see below for more details.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

[b]1. Compensation:[/b]
   - [Exclusive] Charm Legendary Reversion Essence x1

[b]2. Compensation Claim Period:[/b]
 - Can claim from your mail from Sept. 12 (Tue) 19:00 - Sept. 18 (Mon) 23:59 (UTC+9)
 ※ The compensation will only be sent once per account, and the mail will be stored for 3 days (72 hours).
          ┗ You can only claim the compensation from either Standard or Season Mode.
※ Compensation can only be claimed by accounts that are created before the compensation mail is sent, and cannot be claimed by accounts that are created afterwards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

﻿﻿﻿﻿We would like to apologize again for not being able to update the new content according to the schedule we announced previously.
We will always strive to maintain the quality and reliability of our services.

Thank you.

notes.title: Advance Notice on Upcoming Changes with Aug. 31 Update
notes.notes:
Greetings, Rune Hunters.

There will be various changes coming into effect with the Act 13 Hira update that is taking place on Aug. 31 (Thu).

Among these changes, we would like to inform you in advance of the content that will be reset, information regarding the end of Season 1, as well as the temporary suspension of Auction House trading that will take place in preparation for the Season 2 update.

[b]■ Temporary Suspension of Auction House[/b]

[b]◆ Auction House Suspension Measures[/b]

After the Aug. 24 (Thu) patch, you will no longer be able to register new items at the Auction House.

Items that are registered before the patch will remain registered in the Auction House for their remaining time.

On Aug. 29 (Tue), all Auction House features will be temporarily suspended.
Please collect items from failed/successful trades before this date.

After the Aug. 31 (Thu) update, the temporary suspension measures over the Auction House will be lifted.
After the Aug. 31 (Thu) maintenance, you will be able to use the Auction House as normal.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]
[b]■ Content Reset[/b]

[b]◆ Chaos Dungeon Reset and Current Chaos Cards[/b]

With the Aug. 31 (Thu) Hira update, your current Chaos Compendium Score and Chaos Statue Level will be reset.

You will be able to use Saluto and Chaos Dungeons once you have cleared the new Act 13 Hira.
We hope you are excited for the new map and the various events that will be added.

Chaos Cards obtained before the update that you currently own can be used until the update takes place.

Once the Chaos Statue is reset, you will need to obtain new Chaos Cards in order to play Chaos Dungeons.

Any Chaos Cards that you do not use before the Act 13 Hira update will be converted into event items during the update.

The Chaos items that will be converted include all Chaos Cards and Chaos Chard Chests, Chaos Keys and chests that include Chaos Keys.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]
[b]◆ Black Market Reset[/b]

With the Aug. 31 (Thu) update, the Black Market’s Friendship level, item list, saved items, and Pirate’s Coins will be reset.

The Pirate's Coins and Pirate's Coin Chests that you own will be deleted with the update.
Please purchase any saved items before the update takes place. 

Your saved items on the Black Market will be deleted after the update and we will send you the ‘Deeds of Promise’ you used for the deleted items.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]
[b]◆ Relic and Zodiac Reset[/b]
After the Aug. 31 (Thu) update, your Relics and Zodiacs will be reset.

Your Relic Level and EXP, and any Light of Life that you own, will be combined based on whichever values are higher out of Season/Standard mode. 

All Avatar information will be reset and Divinity Points will be given depending on your combined Relic Level.

Please log in after the update to activate your character’s Relic Avatar and reassign your Divinity Points, as well as your Zodiac Traits and Stat Points.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]
[b]◆ Constellation of Time Reset[/b]

After the Aug. 31 (Thu) update, your Constellation of Time stage and your Powerful Emotions will be reset.
Please ensure that you complete any Constellation of Time stages you are playing before the update.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]
[b]◆ Zodiac Stone Emotion Engraving Reset[/b]
After the Aug. 31 (Thu) update, your Emotion Engravings on Zodiac Stones will be reset.
You can perform Emotion Engraving again through Constellation of Time after the update.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]
[b]◆ Mastery Reset[/b]
After the Aug. 31 (Thu) update, your Mastery will be reset.

Your Mastery Level will be combined based on whichever level is higher out of Season/Standard mode.
Please log in after the update to reassign your reset Mastery Points.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]
[b]■ Balance and Content Adjustments[/b]

[b]◆ Changes to Disassemble Rewards due to Addition of Higher Option Tiers for Gear[/b]
After the Aug. 31 (Thu) update, higher tiers will be added to item options.

Due to this change in tier range, the disassemble results from before and after the update may be different even if the same item is disassembled.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]
[b]◆ Deletion of Challenge Mode[/b]

With the Aug. 31 (Thu) update, the new Hardcore and Origin Modes will be added and the current Challenge Mode will be deleted.

The Challenge Mode rewards, Stardust of Evolution Ⅰ and Ⅱ, will be available through Saluto Chaos sub quests.

※ There may be changes in Zodiac Specialization values due to the changed method for obtaining Stardust of Evolution. 
If your Zodiac Specialization values decrease, please obtain Stardust of Evolution through Chaos Sub Quests before using them. (Added on Aug. 31 22:20 (UTC+9))

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]
[b]◆ Changes to Descent Raid Schedule[/b]

Changes have been made to the Descent Raid schedule before the Season 2 update so that we can ensure the stability of our services.

Please see the Content Schedule page for more details.
[[url=https://ud.floor.line.games/us/bbsCmn/detail/1684840347193025906]Link to Content Schedule Page[/url]]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]
[b]◆ Crusade of Glory Ranking Rewards to Not be Sent on Sept. 4 (Mon) [/b](Added on Aug. 24 12:30 (UTC+9))
As the way in which we send Crusade of Glory Ranking Rewards will change with the Season 2 update,
please note that Crusade of Glory Ranking Rewards for matches played between Aug. 28 (Mon) – Sept. 3 (Sun) will not be sent to users on the above date.

We ask for your understanding on this matter.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]
[b]◆ Partial Rune Awakening Reset[/b] (Added on Aug. 25 13:50 (UTC+9))
After the Aug. 31 (Thu) update, some Awakened Runes will be reset due to balance changes.
If you own any Runes that will be reset, we will send you Engraving Stones and Gold according to the type of Rune you have
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]
[b]■ Information on End of Season 1[/b]

[b]◆ Season Mode Items that will Move to Standard Mode at End of Season 1[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/533e3bc7e2f8f59f5cb8d5891159a9e1b9aba1d4.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]
[b]◆ Items that will Move to Temporary Storage at End of Season 1[/b]
The items in your Season Character’s Storage will be moved to Temporary Storage.
The items registered in your Season Character’s Unique/Rune Compendium will be moved to Temporary Storage.
The items in your Season Character’s Alchemy Slots will be moved to Temporary Slots.
The items in your Season Character’s Mailbox will be moved to Temporary Slots.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]
[b]※ To Note[/b]
✔ We will not be able to offer you any assistance for any Black Market items that you do not claim before the Aug. 31 (Thu) maintenance.
✔ Items moved to Temporary Storage and Temporary Slots will be deleted if not claimed before the start of Season 3.

We hope that the information above will help you avoid any inconvenience as you play the game.
We hope you are looking forward to the new update and Season 2.

Thank you.

■ Auction House
- Users’ management of Auction House items will change from being based on character to being based on account.
Please see below for related changes.
  ㄴ All items registered for sale will be viewable to all characters in your account.
  ㄴ Once an item has been auctioned, users will be able to receive payment with characters that did not register the sold item.
E.g.) The payment for an auctioned item that was registered for sale by Character A can be claimed by Character B (however, users cannot claim payments more than once).
  ㄴ All characters in the same mode will be able to cancel items registered for sale.
  ㄴ All items you bid on will be viewable to all characters in your account.
  ㄴ All characters in your account will be able to re-bid.
  ㄴ All characters in your account will be able to receive items after re-bids and after canceled/failed bids.
- After the update, the waiting time for receiving Rubies after selling an item at the Auction House will only be applied when Paid Rubies are included in the trade.
  ㄴ To prevent abuse, Auction House items purchased with Paid Rubies will not be available to re-register for a set amount of time.

Please see below for the affected Rankings.
  └ EXP Ranking / Training Arena Ranking / Chaos Mission Ranking / Spire of Barrier Individual Ranking / Void Rift Ranking

■ Chaos Stones

The Zodiac Pass product will be updated.
✔ Passes can be used and purchased from ‘Event’ in the upper right corner.

■ Zodiac Pass Use Period
- After the Jun. 22 (Thu) maintenance – Until before the Jul. 6 (Thu) maintenance

■ What is the Zodiac Pass?
- Purchasing a Zodiac Pass applies the following benefits during the Pass period: 
Alchemy Slot + 1, Formula Slot +1, Alchemy Brewing Acceleration +50%, Zodiac Free Reset
- By clearing Zodiac Pass missions, you can collect EXP and raise your Pass Level.
You can then obtain the various rewards corresponding to each level.
- Pass Rewards are available for up to Level 20, and you can only obtain rewards for each level once.
- Zodiac Passes are applied according to mode within each account, and once purchased, its effects are also applied separately according to mode.
This means that Zodiac Pass missions, rewards, and levels are shared within each mode.
E.g.) Your play in Standard Mode will not be affected by your Pass in Season Mode.

- Purchased Premium Rewards will only be applied during the current pass period, so please make sure to claim them before the period expires.

※ The outlined period and details above may be subject to change.

Thank you.

■ Void Rift

  You will not be able to receive previous rewards once the period ends,
  so please collect all rewards before the maintenance takes place.
- Each Void Rift will take place for 2 weeks.
- The difficulty of some bosses that use Summon Skills in Void Rifts will be lowered.

■ Constellation of Time
- The confusing Constellation of Time Memory ‘Amplify Element’ display will be deleted. 

■ Black Market 
- The following items will no longer be sold at the Black Market.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/a807df26a1b2ce9004d88a869d1f960f412be963.png[/img]

■ Alchemy
- The icon for the Alchemy Mastery Trait ‘Master of Bargaining Ⅲ’ will change.

　* [Exclusive] Link Rune Engraving Stone Piece

　※ Source: Chaos Mission → Synthesis
　※ The above 2 Link Runes can be obtained from Magic Synthesis Link Rune Selection Chests /
        Rare Synthesis Link Rune Selection Chests / Improved Magic Link Rune Selection Chests /
        Improved Rare Link Rune Selection Chests.

■ Ore Shop
- The items below will be sold from the Gemstones of Merit Shop.
   * [Exclusive] Skill Rune Engraving Stone Piece
   * [Exclusive] Link Rune Engraving Stone Piece

	
■ Tooltips
- The descriptions for some Skill Runes will be changed as follows:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/b1904c9ced17cc7b9cd62688b58b559b498d8ac4.png[/img]

- For the ‘Wheel Slash (Verity)’ Skill Rune tooltip, the ‘Skill Buff Stack Count +n’ phrase will be changed to ‘Max DoT Stacks +n'.
   └ The actual effect will be the same as before.

■ Compendium
- With the changes in sources for some Runes, the information that can be viewed
  through the ‘Rune Compendium – Source’ filter will change.

■ Titles
- The phrase ‘Account Title’ will be deleted from some descriptions related to Titles.

■ Items
- The ‘Minion Block Expertise +’ and ‘Sentry Block Expertise +’ options from the Minion/Sentry Belt options

- The drop chance of Traces of Creation obtained from Memory Rune events will be significantly increased.
- Among the Auction House keywords for the Unique Item ‘Ortemis' Rejuvenation’,

　└ On hit/Additional Element DMG → Per Accumulated Overheat/% HP Regen per Sec

■ Sealed Runes
- New Sealed Runes will be added.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/396fe67ce79f0e68052d037f94922165e4269906.png[/img]

■ Storage
- The following item slots will be added to the Exclusive Essence Storage:
  [Exclusive] Skill Rune Engraving Stone Piece
  [Exclusive] Link Rune Engraving Stone Piece
  [Exclusive] Runestone Magic Link Essence Piece
  [Exclusive] Runestone Rare Link Essence Piece

■ Skill Rune
- The control feedback for the ‘Deadly Poison Skewer’ skill will be improved. 

■ Crafting
- The max for the Totem Duration +% crafting option Totem Effect +% tier appearance will be adjusted.
   * Before: 7, 10 
   * After: 7, 10, 12

■ Zodiac Pass
- Zodiac Pass 2 will end.
  You will not be able to claim Zodiac Pass 2 rewards after the May. 25 (Thu) scheduled maintenance,
 so please claim the relevant rewards before then.
- Zodiac Pass 3 will begin!
  For more details, please check the in-game ‘Event’ tab in the upper right corner of the screen.
- The Zodiac Pass period will last for 2 weeks.

■ Runestones
- When obtaining Runestones through drops in Descent Raids or with Alchemy Synthesis,
  the minimum obtained level for each Runestone will be adjusted as follows:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/7ba74cac44d2eda4666fa097815dbcd8a989f08b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/0ae33fff8954ca51ed8ee8fd066be0094addcd84.png[/img]

[strike]■ Charms
- The probability of obtaining a higher tier than before for Charm tiers that are obtained from Charm Synthesis will be partially increased.[/strike] (05/25 13:55 (UTC+9) Edited)

[b]■ Other[/b]
- The UI will be improved to enhance the visibility of the grade category button within the sell and disassemble screens. (05/26 18:20 (UTC+9) Added)


[b]◈ New Products[/b]
※ These are the new products that will be added with the update. 

◆ Zodiac Pass 3
The Zodiac Pass product will be updated.
✔ Passes can be used and purchased from ’Event’ in the upper right corner.

■ Zodiac Pass Use Period
- After the May. 25 (Thu) maintenance – Until before the Jun. 8 (Thu) maintenance

■ What is the Zodiac Pass?
- Purchasing a Zodiac Pass applies the following benefits during the Pass period:
  Alchemy Slot + 1, Formula Slot +1, Alchemy Brewing Acceleration +50%, Zodiac Free Reset
- By clearing Zodiac Pass missions, you can collect EXP and raise your Pass Level.
  You can then obtain the various rewards corresponding to each level.
- Pass Rewards are available for up to Level 20, and you can only obtain rewards for each level once.
- Zodiac Passes are applied according to mode within each account, and once purchased,
  its effects are also applied separately according to mode.
  This means that Zodiac Pass missions, rewards, and levels are shared within each mode. 
  E.g.) Your play in Standard Mode will not be affected by your Pass in Season Mode.

■ Zodiac Pass Rewards
- Normal Rewards: Can be obtained when your Zodiac Pass Level increases.
- Premium Rewards: Can be obtained when you purchase the Premium Pass and your Zodiac Pass Level increases.
  Details on rewards for each level can be found within the game.

■ Premium Rewards
- If you purchase the Premium Zodiac Pass, you can receive Premium Rewards in addition to Normal Rewards
  when your Pass Level increases.
- With Premium Rewards, you can obtain higher value rewards such as [Exclusive] Skill Rune Engraving Stones.
- Purchased Premium Rewards will only be applied during the current pass period,
  so please make sure to claim them before the period expires.

■ To Note
※ The outlined period and details above may be subject to change.
※ Once the Zodiac Pass period ends, your progress level, points, and rewards will be changed and reset.
※ If you have activated level rewards, please claim them before the end of the period.
※ Premium Rewards can only be claimed if you purchase the Premium Pass.
※ These products may be resold in a same or similar format in the future.


[b]◈ Bug Fixes[/b]
※ These are the bug fixes that will take place with the update.

■ Runestones
- The issue where incorrect Runestone levels are obtained when synthesizing Runestones through Alchemy will be fixed.

■ Chaos Dungeons

  created with upgraded Chaos Cards will be fixed.
- The issue where the displayed Chaos Dungeon level and tier are different between Party Members
  when playing Chaos Dungeons in a Party will be fixed.

■ Constellation of Time

  for Stage 4 of Constellation of Time will be fixed.

■ Monsters
- The issue where Crowd Control is applied on monsters summoned by Evermund will be fixed.
- The issue where the area skill effect of Subject Slaughterer is not displayed will be fixed. 

■ Black Market
- The issue where, after purchasing an item from the Black Market, the ‘Identify’ button is not displayed
  when selecting a Chaos Card of Magic grade or higher from the Chaos Statue will be fixed.

■ Party
- The issue where the notification UI for the Recruit Party category in the Chat is displayed incorrectly
  when promoting a Party will be fixed.
- The issue where Party Member icons do not disappear from the minimap when members leave the Party will be fixed.
 
■ Guild
- The issue where in certain circumstances, the Guild Master is not included in the number of people logged in will be fixed.
- The issue where only the Guild Master cannot use Guild buffs in certain circumstances will be fixed.
[strike]- The issue where the Guild Master promotion cooldown is applied incorrectly will be fixed. [/strike]
※ This issue will be fixed during the Jun. 8 (Thu) scheduled maintenance.
    We will notify you through a notice if this schedule changes.

■ Recruitment Board
- The issue where the notification UI for the Recruitment Board continues to be displayed
  even after claiming all rewards will be fixed.

■ Mailbox
- The issue where, when claiming Currency items from mail, Currency cannot be received through ‘Receive All’
  when inventory is full will be fixed.
- The issue where received mail cannot be checked in the mailbox will be fixed.

■ Item Compendium
- The issue where users cannot register the ‘Maximized DMG Increase’ Link Rune in their Item Compendium
  with Standard Mode characters in certain circumstances will be fixed.
- The issue where certain gear items cannot be registered in Item Compendium - Unique Compendium will be fixed.

■ Chaos Compendium
- The issue where Chaos Compendium progress does not increase beyond a certain score will be fixed.

■ Tooltips
- The issue where the phrase, ‘Cannot link Parallel Multishot Link Rune’, is missing from the tooltip
  for the ‘Toxic Flame (Verity)’ Skill Rune will be fixed. 
  └ The actual effect will be the same as before.

■ Paid Shop
- The issue where products related to Storage are sometimes displayed in the Paid Shop
  despite having already been purchased will be fixed.

■ Inventory
- The issue where Descent Raid rewards cannot be claimed when Inventory is full will be fixed.

■ Items
- The issue where the ‘Chance to gain Pulverize for 3 s on hit’ option of some items is not applied will be fixed.
- The issue where options are not added when trying to enchant a certain item
  with a Rare Imbue Essence in its 6th slot will be fixed.

■ Trading Keys
- The issue where, despite changing an item to tradable with a Trading Key,
  the Trading Key is displayed in the Bag and can be registered for use will be fixed.

■ Crafting
- The issue where items imbued with a certain option before the Apr. 27 (Thu) update cannot be crafted will be fixed. 
　└ Affected option: DoT % Amplification

■ Skill Runes
- The issue where the cooldowns of different Totem Skill Runes are shared will be fixed.
- The issue where the Soul Gem’s Skill Rune Cooldown Recovery Speed option
  does not apply to Avatar Acuben’s Curse of Storm skill will be fixed.
- The issue where the ‘Chain Attack count‘ description for the ‘Quick Slash (Verity)’ skill is displayed differently
  in the tooltips for the Compendium and Rune Awakening screen will be fixed.
- The issue where the ‘Flamethrower’ skill effect is not displayed in certain circumstances will be fixed.
- The issue where the ‘Piercing’ Link Rune does not link to the Skill Runes below will be fixed.
　└ Affected Skill Runes: Shockwave Arrow / Piercing Arrow / Scorching Arrow
[strike]- The issue where the skill effect buff sometimes does not activate when using the Quick Slash (Verity) skill will be fixed. [/strike](05/24 11:15 (UTC+9) Edited)

■ Avatars
- The issue where from the passive effects of Avatar of Casthor, the ‘Enhance Sanctum Effect’ does not work properly
  on certain Sanctums will be fixed.

■ Auction House
- The issue where items that cannot be registered in the Auction House are displayed as ‘Auction Failed’
  and can be reobtained will be fixed.

■ Charm
- The issue where the results of Charm Synthesis are different than intended when spending 2 or less high tier materials will be fixed. (05/25 13:55 (UTC+9) Added)

■ Other
- The frame drop issue for Act 12 stages will be fixed. 
- The frame drop issue that occurs when entering Golden Ring Chaos Dungeons for some device models will be improved.
- The issue where the UI is incorrectly displayed for some languages when ‘Miss’ occurs during battle will be fixed.
  ※ Affected Languages: Chinese (Simplified), Chinese (Traditional)



We hope that these update details will help you avoid any inconvenience as you play the game.

Thank you.

notes.title: May. 11 Update (May. 16 19:30 (UTC+9) Added)
notes.notes:
Greetings, Rune Hunters.

Our next update will take place on May. 11 (Thu). 
Please see below for more details.

※ The following updates may change or be postponed when the update takes place.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]

◈ Improvements and Other Changes
※ These are the improvements and changes that will come into place with the update.

◆ Improvements and Other Changes

■ Tooltips
- The tooltip for the Deadly Poison Skewer Skill Rune will change.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/0a38de8925253bf9fe2f9bf1d1dcca47f6a1b8a0.png[/img]

- The tooltip for the Deadly Poison Claw Skill Rune will change.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/346d0e9624a38313287905d8c78498a270adafec.png[/img]

- The tooltip for the Flamethrower Skill Rune will change.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/48dfce1042cd512435611274b56e07afb86f7db6.png[/img]

■ Stats
- The stat names below will change.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/a2ad6697d7aeb908930524b7a88e71b69fe98635.png[/img]

- Detailed descriptions will be added to Link Rune tooltips, and you can check them by selecting the relevant stat in the game.
	ㄴ When Status Effects occur, the DMG that determines the effect and duration is amplified,
     so higher effect and duration values are applied. 

■ Void Rift – New Season
- The previous season of Void Rift will end, and a new season will begin!
  Your Void Rift progress, Rank Points, and reward history is reset every season.
  The boss monsters of each area will also change once the Void Rift is reset.
  You will not be able to receive the previous season’s rewards once the season ends,
  so please be sure to collect all rewards before maintenance takes place.
- Each Void Rift season will take place for 2 weeks.

■ Descent Raids
- The ‘Magroth’ Descent Raid will end.
- The ‘Trischema’ Descent Raid will start.
- The ‘Vilam’ Descent Raid will start on May. 18 (Thu). 
- Descent Raids take place for 2 weeks, and are followed by a 1-week reward period. 

■ Inventory
- Charms will be separated from gear in the Inventory tab.

■ Auction House
- Sealed Runes will be moved from the ‘Others’ category to the ‘Rune’ category in the Auction House. 

■ Paid Shop
- UI will be improved so users can scroll when there are 5 or more grantable items from the items for sale at the Paid Shop. 
- The purchase limit per purchase of Memory Runes and God’s Resonance Stones has been lifted.

■ Rankings
- Rankings exclusive to Seasons will be marked differently to normal rankings.

■ Map Exploration Rate
- The method for claiming rewards for map exploration rates will change from claiming for each stage → claiming all in one go.
	ㄴ The ‘Receive Reward‘ button will change to a ‘Receive All’ button,
     and when the ‘Receive All’ button is selected, all exploration rate rewards that have not yet been received will be claimed. 

■ DMG
- A differentiating DMG font feature will be added so that Maximized DMG can be seen more easily.

■ Alchemy
- The ‘Trigger Rune Change Essence’ section in the Alchemy Combining/Essence menu
  will be changed to ‘[Exclusive] Trigger Rune Change Essence’.
- Each World's Memory Tier/Grade section in the Alchemy Combining menu will be improved
  so that multiple can be crafted at the same time. 
- A section where you can combine [Exclusive] Traum’s Crystal Pieces with Traum's Crystal Pieces
  will be added to the Alchemy Combining/Other menu. 
- After the update, you will get [Exclusive] items when combining Trigger Rune Change Essences.
- After the update, you will be able to use [Exclusive] Rune Link Essences as material
   when combining Trigger Rune Change Essences.
- Costs for combining Trigger Rune Change Essences will change.
  ㄴ Before: Rune Link Essence x500, Philosopher's Stone x5
       After: Rune Link Essence x100
- After the update, items obtained in the previous Season will be available to transfer
  in gear transfer in the Alchemy Transfer menu. 
  However, they cannot be transferred with items acquired from new Seasons.

■ Chaos Dungeons 
- When playing Chaos Dungeons, ‘Rune Hunter's Resolve’,
  which allows you to obtain additional Statue EXP, will be applied.
※ 'Rune Hunter’s Resolve’ applies different values for different periods.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/669379474260409f1943dd63819e745360ffe142.png[/img]

■ Other
- Emphasized sound effects for when Crystal Orbs and Chaos Crystals are dropped will be removed.


◈ New Products
※ The following is information on the new products that will be added with the update.

◆ Zodiac Pass – Season 2
The Zodiac Pass product will be updated.
✔ Passes can be used and purchased from ’Event’ in the upper right corner.

■ Zodiac Pass Use Period
- After the May. 11 (Thu) maintenance – Until before the May. 25 (Thu) maintenance 

■ What is the Zodiac Pass?
- Purchasing a Zodiac Pass applies the following benefits during the Pass period:
  Alchemy Slot + 1, Formula Slot +1, Alchemy Brewing Acceleration +50%, Zodiac Free Reset 
- By clearing Zodiac Pass ‘missions’, you can collect EXP and raise your Pass Level.
  You can then obtain the various rewards corresponding to each level.
- Pass Rewards are available for up to Level 20, and you can only obtain rewards for each level once.
- Zodiac Passes are applied according to mode within each account,
  and once purchased, its effects are also applied separately according to mode.
  Zodiac Pass missions, rewards, and levels are shared within each mode.
  E.g.) Playing in Standard Mode will not be affected by your Pass in Season Mode.

■ Zodiac Pass Rewards
- Normal Rewards: Can be obtained when your Zodiac Pass level increases.
- Premium Rewards: Can be obtained when you purchase the Premium Pass and your Zodiac Pass level increases.
 Details on rewards for each level can be found within the game.

■ Premium Rewards
- If you purchase the Premium Zodiac Pass, you can receive Premium Rewards
  in addition to Normal Rewards when your Pass Level increases.
- With Premium Rewards, you can obtain higher value rewards
  such as [Exclusive] Skill Rune Legendary Upgrade Essences.
- Purchased Premium Rewards will only be applied during the current season,
  so please make sure to claim them before the Pass period expires.

■ To Note
※ The outlined period and details above may be subject to change.
※ With the Zodiac Pass, progress levels, points, and rewards will be changed and reset once the season ends.
※ If you have activated level rewards, please claim them before the end of the season.
※ Premium Rewards can only be claimed if you purchase the Premium Pass.
※ These products may be resold in a same or similar format in the future.


◈ Balance Changes
※ These are the Character, Rune, Monster, and other balance changes that will be made.

■ Drops
- The drop chance of higher-grade Earth Elements dropping for higher monster levels will be increased. 
- Among Rare Essences, the appearance chances for Rare Upgrade Essences, Rare Imbue Essences,
  Rare Expansion Essences, Charm Rare Upgrade Essences, Charm Rare Change Essences,
  Skill Rune Rare Upgrade Essences, and Link Rune Rare Upgrade Essences will be increased. 
- When Charms are dropped, the chance of Rare Charms being dropped
  and the Rare Charm change chance due to the rarity of discovered items will be significantly increased.
- Chaos Event: The drop chance of items in Chaotic Realms will be increased. 
- Chaos Event: With the Serpens Statue, the drop chance of Charm Essences from the statue
  and from the monsters summoned by the statue will be significantly increased.
- Chaos Event: With the Serpens Statue, the Elite monsters summoned by the statue
  will drop large amounts of Darkness Energy after the update.
- The amount of Normal Rune Essences dropped by Elite monsters will be increased.
- The amount of Essences dropped in Chaos Dungeons will be increased.

■ Charms
- The chance of Rare Charms appearing when synthesizing Magic Charms will be increased from 3% to 30%.
- The chance of high-tier Charms appearing when synthesizing Charms will be increased.
※ The standards for changing Tier will be based on the highest tier among registered Charms, and cannot exceed Tier 8.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/4943efefaf841c399e0c45a7ff08a5428c301996.png[/img]

■ Monsters
- The difficulty of certain skills of Four-legged Bartus will be decreased.
- The Freeze duration of Treasure Chests has increased slightly.

◈ Bug Fixes
※ These are the bug fixes that will take place with the update.

■ Storage
- Restoration for the issue where items disappeared from Storage have been completed.
	ㄴ Restored items have been sent to your in-game mail, so please check your mailbox.
	ㄴ As mail have a storage period, please make sure to claim your items within the period.
    If you do not claim the items within the period,
    please note that we may not be able to offer you additional assistance on the matter, such as sending the items again.

■ Options
- The issue where the ‘+% DMG for 3 s upon using a potion’ option for the Unique item, ‘Golden Band of Opportunity’,
  does not work when using Mana/Enhance Potions, will be fixed. 

■ Compendium
- The issue where users’ Chaos Compendium progress is reset will be fixed. 
	ㄴ Restored items have been sent to your in-game mail, so please check your mailbox.
ㄴ As mail have a storage period, please make sure to claim your items within the period.
    If you do not claim the items within the period,
    please note that we may not be able to offer you additional assistance on the matter, such as sending the items again.
- The issue where the Item Compendium Collection Effect is not applied when selecting a character will be fixed.

■ Quests
- The issue where users cannot complete the sub quest ‘Searching for Traces’ in certain circumstances will be fixed. 
　→ If you experience this issue, please complete the quest by talking to NPC ‘Robu’ in Symmesbicul.
- The issue where quest tier values are not displayed for some quests that have Chaos Dungeon tier conditions will be fixed.
- The issue where directions for navigating the quest is not displayed
  during Act 11 ‘Investigate Special Hatchery Room’ will be fixed.
 
■ Titles
- The issue where Standard character Titles change to being unowned
  when Titles are obtained with a Season character will be fixed. 
- The issue where Titles related to Achievements in Within the Storm will be fixed.

■ Tooltips
- Changes will be made so that the phrase, ‘Decrease stage every 1 s upon canceling’,
  is displayed in the Fire Torrent [Source] Awakening tooltip.

■ Runestones 
- The issue where use of Trading Keys when previewing Chest contents and when actually obtaining them
  are displayed differently will be fixed. 
- You will be able to obtain Runestones that can be registered at the Auction House through drops after the update.

■ Rune Growth
- The issue where the Rune Growth quick menu is displayed
  even when the quick menu notification has been turned off will be fixed.

■ Skill Runes

notes.title: Advance Notice on Some Upcoming Changes with the Apr. 27 Update
notes.notes:
Greetings, Rune Hunters.

With the Ganida update on Apr. 27 (Thu) and the introduction of the new Season Mode,
many changes will be coming to Rune Hunters’ journeys in UNDECEMBER.

Among these, we would like to inform you in advance about the changes that will be made
with the Chaos Dungeon reset and the introduction of Season Mode, as well as the content that will be ending.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]
[b]◆ Chaos Dungeon Reset and Current Chaos Cards[/b]
With the Ganida update on Apr. 27 (Thu), the current Chaos Statue Level will be reset. 

After the update, users will only be able to enter Saluto and use the Chaos Dungeons
once they have fully cleared the ACT 12 Ganida story. 

Chaos Cards that are acquired before the update can be used until the update. 
After the Chaos Statue is reset, users must acquire new Chaos Cards in order to use the Chaos Dungeons.

Chaos Cards that are not used before the Ganida update will be converted into event items once the update takes place
and will be available to obtain in Standard Mode.
The types of Chaos items that will be converted include
all Chaos Cards, Chaos Card Chests, Chaos Keys, and Chests that include Chaos Keys.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]
[b]◆ Temporary Suspension of Trade through the Auction House[/b]
Trade of Chaos Cards through the Auction House will be temporarily unavailable after the Apr. 19 (Wed) maintenance.
Chaos Cards and items that have already been registered in the current Auction House
will remain registered for their remaining time. 

The temporary suspension of Chaos Card trade through the Auction House will be lifted after the Ganida update,
so users will be able to use the Auction House normally after the maintenance on Apr. 27 (Thu).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]
[b]◆ Relic and Zodiac Reset[/b]
Relics and Zodiacs will be reset after the Apr. 27 (Thu) update. 
Please activate your character’s Relic Avatar, reset your Divinity Points,
and reset your Zodiac Trait and Stat points once you log in to the game after the update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]
[b]◆ Changes to Alchemy[/b]
The Alchemy feature will be changed so that it is shared within your account after the Apr. 27 (Thu) update. 
As all items that are being crafted through Alchemy will be deleted after the update,
please ensure that you claim items that have been completed before the maintenance.
We also recommend that you refrain from using the Alchemy feature before the maintenance.

Formula Books will also be changed so that they are shared within your account,
and all Formula Books that have been used for characters will be reset.  
After this, we will send users the same amount of ‘Formula Book Selection Chests’
as the number of Formula Books they have used for the characters in their accounts. 
E.g.) If you have used one [Formula Book] Cold DMG Orb for Character A and one for Character B, you will receive 2 chests. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]
[b]◆ Changes to Crafting[/b]
Crafting Levels (Weapon/Armor/Accessory) will be deleted after the Apr. 27 (Thu) update. 
We will send all the Star Memory and Currency that have been used for growing Crafting Levels for each item to users.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]
[b]◆ Changes to Rune Awakening[/b]
With the improvements that will be made to Rune Awakening after the Apr. 27 (Thu) update,
Awakening Stones and Seals of Engraving will be deleted.
For users who own Awakening Stones, we will send them
the same amount of Engraving Stones as the amount of Awakening Stones they own. 
Moreover, as the mechanism for Awakening will be completely changing,
we will be resetting Awakening and sending users Engraving Stones according to Rune types.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]
[b]◆ Changes to Some Items[/b]
Users will no longer be able to acquire Color Elements (Red/Green/Blue) of all grades after the Apr. 27 (Thu) update.
All owned Color Elements will be changed to Earth Elements according to their grade.
However, as the schedule for changing these items has not yet been confirmed,
we will inform you through a future notice when the changes are made.

Star Crystals will be deleted once the Chaos Compendium is renewed,
and any owned Star Crystals will be changed to Darkness Energy.
Gold that has been used for growth for the current Chaos Compendium will be sent to users after the update. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]
[b]◆ Changes to Some Convenience Features[/b]
The method for unlocking Alchemy Brewing slots and Formula Page slots will change after the Apr. 27 (Thu) update. 
We will send the Currency already used to unlock these slots to users. 

In addition, as the default number of spaces provided for Bags will also change,
we will send the Currency used to expand Bags to those users who have already expanded their Bags.
※ We will send Rubies to those who have used or own Bag expansion items. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]
[b]◆ Changes to Some Pass Products[/b]
The Statue Level Up Pass I and II  will be deleted after the Apr. 27 (Thu) update. 
If you have purchased any of these products and are progressing with the Pass,
please ensure that you claim your Pass items before the maintenance takes place.
 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]
[b]※ To Note[/b]
✔ Please note that we will be unable to offer assistance for Alchemy/Pass items
that have not been claimed before the Apr. 27 (Thu) maintenance. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41639947/e7bc4a197fb4f524c495316febae0ea8118ab89a.png[/img]
We hope the information above will help you avoid any inconvenience,
and hope that you will look forward to and support the new Ganida update and Season Mode.

Thank you.

[b]◆ Descent Raid - Season 7[/b]
- A new season of Descent Raids is coming!
✔ You can enter the new raid through the Recruitment Board in each Act Town or in Saluto.

[b]■ Descent Raid Details[/b]
- A new season of Descent Raids, Trischema and Ochogneel, is coming!
Trischema will start on Mar. 29 (Wed) and last 2 weeks, whilst Ochogneel will start on Apr. 5 (Wed) and last 2 weeks.
When the raids open, select the boss for the raid before matching and entering.
The raids’ opening times will be the same as previous raids.

- You can obtain a Unique Runestone once you defeat the Descent Raid boss.
